text:
maria: Heads-up — master CI is red on a bunch of integration tests since ~08:43. Failing job: integration-tests/gh-9123. Error looks like mock-kafka connection timeouts and some redis mock 502s.

jordan: :eyes: saw the alerts. Which tests specifically?

maria: Mostly consumer_integration_test::kafka_consumer_end_to_end and stream_processor_integration::reload-on-failure. Quick log snippet: 
```
ERROR org.test.MockKafkaClient - failed to connect to kafka-test-01:9092: Connection refused
Caused by: java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused
...
WARN  redis.mock - 502 Bad Gateway from redis-proxy-test
```

priyanka: Could be the mock-kafka docker container on the ci-runner host OOM'ing again. Last week we saw the same pattern.

sam: @oncall-bot can you check the test infra health for env "ci-runner-03" and mock services? Prefer a restart if the mock-kafka container is in crashloop.

oncall-bot: Incident check: ci-runner-03: mock-kafka CPU spike 08:41–08:46, restarted automatically by systemd at 08:47. Service flapping resumed at 08:50. Opened ticket INFRA-4312.

jordan: Thanks. For immediate unblock, can someone rerun the affected workflow? If it's transient a rerun might clear it.

ci-bot: Rerun queued for integration-tests/gh-9123 by jordan — build #5642.

maria: Rerun came back with same failures after ~4m. Looks deterministic under load.

priyanka: Requesting a manual check of docker logs on ci-runner-03: sudo journalctl -u mock-kafka.service -n 200 and docker ps on that host. Might be too small heap for the new consumer test patterns.

sam: I'll SSH in now and tail logs. Will post findings.

sam: tail shows repeated GC pauses and OOMKilled for mock-kafka image (heap Xmx set to 512m). Last restart: 08:47, multiple restarts since.

maria: That matches. We recently merged a test change that increases parallel consumers (PR #7834). Can someone bisect to confirm? If it's that PR we rollback.

jordan: I can bisect quickly. Plan: revert PR locally and run the failing integration test on ci-runner-03 in a dev job to reproduce. Will post results in ~20m.

priyanka: As a short-term mitigation, increase mock-kafka container memory to 1G on ci-runner-03 or add a second mock-kafka instance behind the proxy. If ops approves.

oncall-bot: Ops escalation recommended. Auto-suggest: bump container memory; add restart limit.

sam: I can increase memory now and restart the service. Doing that -> `sudo systemctl stop mock-kafka && docker rm -f mock-kafka && docker run --name mock-kafka -e KAFKA_HEAP=1024m ...`

maria: :thumbsup: do that, then we should rerun the bad jobs and queue a canary run with the new config. Also open a follow-up to tune the test to not spawn so many parallel consumers by default.

sam: Done — started with 1g heap, container stable for 2m with no OOMs.

ci-bot: Rerun triggered: integration-tests/gh-9123 rerun #2 by sam.

jordan: Bisect result: reverted PR #7834 locally — tests pass on ci-runner-03 with original test config. So the PR increases parallelism causing higher memory pressure on mock-kafka.

maria: OK actionable items: 1) revert or patch PR #7834 to reduce parallel consumers (owner: jordan) 2) increase default heap for mock-kafka in CI images (owner: sam/priyanka) 3) add flaky guard around those tests until infra is stabilized (owner: priyanka) 4) postmortem note in #postmortems (owner: maria).

priyanka: I'll open INFRA-4313 to bump default heap in our CI AMI and add a healthcheck that restarts container proactively.

jordan: I'll push a fix to #7834 to cap parallelism to 4 and request a fast review.

maria: Great. Leaving the thread open until PR fix merged and a stable run observed. Thanks all. :coffee:

ci-bot: integration-tests/gh-9123 rerun #2 succeeded — all tests green. Notifying thread.

maria: Nice — marking incident as mitigated. Will follow up with postmortem tomorrow.

priyanka: Adding a quick note: add metrics for mock-kafka memory usage to infra dashboard so we catch this earlier.

sam: Added dashboard card.

maria: End of thread for now.
